summary: Release a finished local lease through explicit current-owner handoff

delivery.outcome: Provide an exact-owner, fenced and recoverable terminal lease release for local-single-clone controllers.
nonGoals: No timeout takeover, invalid completed normalization, unknown-owner release, worktree or branch deletion, hosted approval or adopter activation.
Frozen publication phases require their existing controller; do not manufacture missing approval transitions.

architecture.decision: Reuse canonical lease transitions and managed terminal-receipt verification. Serialize explicit current-owner handoff with the existing lease lock name; retain a write-ahead receipt for exact idempotent recovery. In-scope owner amendment: include the required CI invocation for the new suite; keep all existing hosted Linux/Windows gates and local verification.
interfaceChanges: The existing hosted verification jobs explicitly execute the new owner-release regression suite.
dataChanges: Ignored local lease revisions/fencing and write-ahead operational receipts only.
architecture.rollback: Preserve original bytes and journal; do not undo accepted release or decrease fencing. Publish corrective code if needed.

validation.evidence: Real Git repositories: exact same-owner release, stale/CAS/foreign/frozen refusals, crash replay and path races.
Managed source package and native governance pass before independent protected publication.
